what_to_detect: A gravestorm trigger resolves and copies its spell once for each permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
near_miss: A gravestorm trigger resolves on a turn no permanent went to a graveyard and makes no copy.
record_fields: spell_copied event (count) of the resolution's effect half
acting line keyword_display_name (a keyword line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)
